# ADR-NNNN: <short decision title>

- Status: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR-XXXX
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD

## Context

What situation forced a decision? What constraints and forces are in play?

## Decision

What was chosen, stated plainly.

## Consequences

What this enables and what it constrains. Include the costs, not only the benefits.

## Revisit when

The condition under which this decision should be reconsidered.

## Sources

Cite a source for every non-obvious factual claim (file paths, config, references).
